title: This Pflugerville home has a resort-level gym & pool 1 min away! 😱 #shorts #realestate
description:
Tour 20813 Carries Ranch Road in Pflugerville, TX! 🏡✨
Welcome to one of the most sought-after spots in Central Texas! Located in the premier Blackhawk neighborhood of Pflugerville, this incredible new listing puts you exactly where you want to be.
Imagine living just a 1-minute walk away from top-tier community amenities, including:
A fully-equipped, full-service gym 🏋️‍♂️
Sparkling community swimming pool 🏊‍♂️
Expansive green spaces & walking trails 🌳
Fun playgrounds for the family 🛝
From the soaring ceilings and open-concept chef's kitchen to the massive primary suite and media-ready spaces, this home is built for both comfort and entertainment.
